page_title: NOT 1-0 CRY | Nottingham Forest v Crystal Palace 21/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Tim Robinson is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) says something out of turn to the referee and is shown a yellow card.
90+5' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Tim Robinson blows for a foul. Nottingham are awarded the free kick.
90+4' Trevoh Chalobah does well to cross from a difficult angle and find Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) on the edge of the six-yard box, but his header slips well wide of the right post.
90+3' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) swings in a cross from the corner, but Matz Sels reads it well and gathers the ball.
90+2' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.

90' Neco Williams (Nottingham) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
89' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
88' Substitution. Daichi Kamada did his best and is replaced by Asher Agbinone (Crystal Palace).
87' Jota Silva (Nottingham) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
84' Rui Pedro Silva prepares a substitution. Chris Wood is replaced by Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham).
84' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) limps off the pitch to be replaced by Ramon Sosa.
83' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
81' Crystal Palace take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
81' Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the left side of the goal, but Matz Sels pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.

80' A loose ball is pounced on by Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Matz Sels is alert and makes a comfortable save.
78' Rui Pedro Silva has decided to substitute Elliot Anderson and he is replaced by Neco Williams (Nottingham).
78' We are about to witness a subsitution. Morato (Nottingham) for Alex Moreno.

77' Chris Wood (Nottingham) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the top of the net. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
77' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) will take the corner.
76' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked. Nottingham get a corner.
74' Oliver Glasner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace) replacing Tyrick Mitchell.
74' It is time for a substitution. Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) is on for Will Hughes.
74' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) connects with the corner but his looping header goes well over.
74' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
72' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Dean Henderson intercepts the ball.
72' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
71' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Dean Henderson.
68' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.

68' Trevoh Chalobah (Crystal Palace) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
67' There's an opportunity for Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
66' Substitution. Eddie Nketiah makes his way off the pitch and Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) comes on as his replacement.

65' 1 - 0 Chris Wood (Nottingham) quickly gets to a rebound. He is not worried how far out he is and slams the ball towards the goal. To the amazement of all, it goes all the way into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:0 with this magnificent strike.
63' The substitution is prepared. Jota Silva (Nottingham) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Anthony Elanga.
63' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) attempts to find Daniel Munoz, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
62' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

62' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The linesman makes the right call and Crystal Palace will have a corner.
62' Crystal Palace quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

61' A great job from two opposing players there. Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) fired a shot nicely in on goal from distance towards the roof of the net, while Matz Sels produced a wonderful piece of goalkeeping to parry the ball onto the bar.
60' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
56' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Dean Henderson is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
54' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.

53' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and drills a good shot to the middle of the goal. Matz Sels shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop the effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity!
52' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
50' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
47' Alex Moreno (Nottingham) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
47' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
46' Tim Robinson blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Chris Wood (Nottingham) runs onto a lofted ball into the box, but hits a weak shot towards the middle of the goal that is easily dealt with by Dean Henderson.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
45' Crystal Palace work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
42' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
40' The foul by Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) was seen by Tim Robinson who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
39' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) makes a slide tackle, but referee Tim Robinson blows for a foul. Crystal Palace earn a free kick.
36' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Ola Aina (Nottingham) heads on.
33' Alex Moreno (Nottingham) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
30' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

28' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards low towards the middle of the goal, but Matz Sels is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
27' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) latches onto a cross and drills a shot towards goal that goes well wide of the right post.

25' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Matz Sels makes a decent save to deny his effort directed low to the middle of the target.
25' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
23' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
23' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header only flies onto the right post and away off it!
23' The referee signals a corner kick to Nottingham.

20' That was absolutely fantastic! Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) tries his luck with a hammer shot from long range, but his effort only rattles the right post! Here is an example of luck not being on your side. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
17' Elliot Anderson crosses and Chris Wood (Nottingham) misses a great opportunity with his head from close in, sending the ball just wide of the right post.

16' The ball from the corner kick lands at the feet of Chris Wood (Nottingham) deep inside the box and he takes a shot. His low strike heads towards the middle of the target, but it's deflected away thanks to a brilliant intervention by one of the defenders.
16' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Nottingham.

16' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) weaves through the defence with ease and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score with his strike towards the bottom left corner as Dean Henderson produces a good save. Nottingham force a corner. They send men into the box.
14' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) gets inside the box and tries to beat Matz Sels with a measured shot into the right side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
13' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
10' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) drills a powerful shot from long range towards the middle of the goal, but Matz Sels makes a comfortable save.
8' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
6' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.

5' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
3' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) tries to find Tyrick Mitchell, but he puts too much power on the pass.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Crystal Palace will have the kick-off.
